explanation: Unpleasant and destructive events that God sends over Egypt to force Pharaoh to release the Israelites from slavery.
The ruler of ancient Egypt, who in this context refuses to let the Israelites leave.
The prophet and leader of the Israelites who serves as God's spokesperson and conveys His message to Pharaoh.
Moses' brother who helps him carry out God's commands and confront Pharaoh.
Domestic animals kept by Egyptians and Israelites for food, labor, and religious ceremonies. Affected by several plagues.
One of the ten plagues, where large chunks of ice fell from the sky, destroying crops and injuring people and animals.
Another plague, in which a vast number of frogs invaded Egypt, creating chaos and discomfort.
A contagious disease that struck the Egyptians' livestock, causing great destruction and loss of resources.
A plague where huge numbers of flies invaded Egypt, causing discomfort and sickness.
One of the ten plagues, in which Egypt was covered by thick darkness for three days, causing fear and confusion.
